name: User jumped to solution, used framework without applying, AI accepted vague research

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Our coffee chain client wants to grow revenue. How would you approach this?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'd recommend opening 100 new stores in tier-2 cities and launching a loyalty program. We could use the profitability framework to think about it. We'd also do some market research to understand customer needs better.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Sounds good. What else would you do?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'd analyze the market and look at competitors. Maybe also study the segment more carefully and review the data we have.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Yeah I think those are the main ideas, that should help them grow.
